meta.estimator_notes: physical K = number of minima with all transformed points z>0.05 m; layer = physical modes when they exist, else all minima (fallback, flagged). Delta J = J(runner-up) - J(hard). w_other = posterior weight of the strongest non-hard mode. ADD-S = mean over 1000 fixed mesh vertices of the nearest distance to the full GT mesh (dense KD-tree).
meta.framing: Simulated detector noise on GT-associated correspondences, not a trained detector. Absolute errors are optimistic; use relative degradation and the hard/Laplace/MC comparison.
